Positive values mean more correct emotion labels at the higher annotated strength.
Matching rules differ; MEAD text equivalence is unverified. Associations, not interventions.
Native strength definitions and matching rules differ across datasets; estimates are shown separately.
This analysis tests emotion-classification sensitivity, not prediction of a strength label.
